chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him: May a man turn around in his salat (prayer)? He said: No, and he should not crack his fingers.

key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.لَا: a negation indicating prohibition or disallowance in this context
key_terms.يَلْتَفِتُ: turns around or looks away during prayer
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: cracks or intertwines in a manner of breaking the set position

ai.seo_question: Is a person allowed to turn around or crack his fingers during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning proper conduct in salat (prayer). It indicates that turning about during the prayer is not permitted, and that cracking the fingers is also to be avoided as part of maintaining the decorum of worship.
